claim: Compile through Claim then Evidence then Verification then Retrieval then Context then Answer. Do not add extra knowledge folders.
Hybrid retrieve uses disposable FTS5 plus one-hop wikilinks recency source authority and contradiction penalty.
Compilation can inject error. A wiki claim needs source plus evidence location before promotion.
Persistence is not truth. Provenance verification and conflict flagging are required.
Git markdown is source of truth. SQLite FTS5 is a disposable index.
Vector DB only when there is too much to read. Setup is markdown plus one CSV.
A memory line stays only if deleting it changes an answer.
Unverified peer claims do not enter wiki or MEMORY.md.
raw/ is immutable. wiki/ is compiled. output/ is derived from wiki.
Do not replace wiki markdown with a second JSONL graph store.
Give the model the relevant subgraph not the dump.
Flag contradictions. Do not silently pick a side.
Embeddings stay parked until the wiki is too large to read.
